text: I keep losing my train of thought. What should I build for this hackathon?
Something that sorts your thoughts for you. You talk, and it builds a map.
Oh wait, I just remembered, I need to buy Mom a birthday present. Her birthday is Saturday.
She mentioned she wants that cookbook. The one about Oaxacan food.
Actually, I should make a reservation for dinner too. That Mexican place on College Street.
They close early on Saturdays, I should call before five.
Anyway back to the hackathon. The placement needs to be under three seconds or it feels broken.
And the refiner runs in the background. It tidies titles and pulls out action items like dates.
I also need to email my landlord about the lease renewal before November tenth.
Right, the refiner should also generate pictures. Little memory palace illustrations for each thread.
For the hackathon demo, the key moment is when you see the map form itself from nothing.
Oh and I forgot to pay the electric bill. That was due yesterday.
I should set up autopay so I stop forgetting—
So the stack for the hackathon is Rust, React, WebSocket, and four Muse models.
The whole point is you think out loud and the app does the organizing.
